name: Venkatesh Chembrolu
abstract_title: An Instantiation of the Consciousness-First Framework: Probabilistic Dynamics of the Screen of Experience
abstract: Conventional approaches to consciousness in cognitive science and physics treat awareness as derivative of material dynamics or neural computation. The Consciousness-First (CF) Framework reverses this assumption, proposing that matter and observation arise as representational appearances within a primary field of consciousness. The framework offers a mathematically rigorous route to formalize this inversion using tools from category theory, information theory, and probabilistic semantics. Buildi
